column1: #mapping_set_description: Wikidata items carrying a P4212 identifier, harvested via SPARQL from https://query.wikidata.org/sparql, restricted to ids found in the local Pactols pactols_sujets dump.

#comment: predicate_id defaults to skos:exactMatch (per project decision); overridden per-row only when the Wikidata statement carries a mapping relation type (P4390) qualifier. mapping_source is the specific Wikidata statement URI. Lieux/Sujets scheme determined by looking up each id against local Pactols RDF dumps (load_pactols_scheme_index(), PACTOLS_DIR) — not from Wikidata itself, since P4212 doesn't distinguish the two schemes.
